description: This file defines the PsrStream class, which adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to a PSR-7 Stream interface, enabling compatibility between Guzzle HTTP client streams and PSR-7 standard streams.

classes.name: PsrStream
classes.description: Adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to conform to PSR-7 StreamInterface, allowing Guzzle streams to be used in PSR-7 compatible applications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PsrStream with a GuzzleStreamInterface object.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Sets the internal stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining contents of the stream.
